verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's open-data page says it publishes machine-readable, platform-independent raw datasets on revenue, expenditures, procurement, taxes and fees. A hands-on probe confirmed that its Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders registry extract answers a keyless Socrata JSON query on data.texas.gov, so no scraping is needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full bulk-file exports (e.g., complete CSV downloads), and first-party docs deeper than a one-line description of the dataset catalog.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping

citations.quote: provides it to the public in machine-readable, platform-independent raw datasets. Here you can find data on revenue, expenditures, procurement, taxes and fees
the Comptroller's Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset answers a keyless Socrata SODA query with structured JSON rows
